# northflank_subdomain (Resource)

Adds a subdomain, such as `api` for `api.example.com`, to a verified domain.

Create a DNS record of type `record_type` named `full_name` with the value `record_value`, then verify with `northflank_subdomain_verification`. Once verified, route it to a service by listing `full_name` in that service's `ports[].domains`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "northflank_subdomain" "api" {
  domain = northflank_domain_verification.root.domain
  name   = "api"
}

output "api_dns_record" {
  value = "${northflank_subdomain.api.full_name} ${northflank_subdomain.api.record_type} ${northflank_subdomain.api.record_value}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Root domain to add the subdomain to. It must be verified first, so pass `northflank_domain_verification.<name>.domain` to get the ordering right. Changing this forces a new subdomain.
- `name` (String) Subdomain to add, such as `api` or `eu.api`, `@` for the domain itself, or `*` for a wildcard. Changing this forces a new subdomain.

### Optional

- `routing_mode` (String) How traffic is routed: `paths` (the default), `geoRouting` or `loadBalancerSubdomain`. Northflank cannot change it later, so changing it forces a new subdomain.

### Read-Only

- `full_name` (String) Full name of the subdomain, such as `api.example.com`. This is what `ports[].domains` takes.
- `id` (String) `<domain>/<name>`.
- `record_type` (String) Type of the DNS record to create, `CNAME` for subdomains.
- `record_value` (String) Value of the DNS record to create.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether Northflank has verified the DNS record.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Subdomains are imported as <domain>/<subdomain>.
terraform import northflank_subdomain.api example.com/api
```
